scoring_justification: Result-level comparison against paper gold with tolerances, plus structural trend checks; T1 recompute infeasible because raw PM3 optimization outputs (logs) are not required scored artifacts, only the final extracted numbers are available.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold distances, bond energies, and charges from paper Tables 1,2,3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted directly from Tables 1,2,3 of the paper (Romanova et al., Russ. J. Bioorg. Chem. 2004)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually digitized from the published tables
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Every value is the exact published number, traceable to the paper.

distances.description: Each complex name (e.g., 'Heme+His+O2') maps to an object of interatomic distances (Fe-O1, Fe-O2, O1-O2, Fe-N(S)aa, Fe-O2_center where applicable, etc.) in Angstroms.

bond_energies.description: Keys are O2 complex names; values are the computed binding energy in kcal/mol.

charges.description: Each complex name maps to an object of Mulliken atomic charges (Fe, O1, O2, N(S)aa for O2 complexes; Fe, N, O, N(S)aa for NO complexes) in elementary charge units.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing all reproduced quantities: internuclear distances, O2 binding energies, and Mulliken atomic charges, as computed from PM3 calculations.

output_contract.notes: Distances are in Angstroms, bond energies in kcal/mol, charges in elementary charge units. For Heme+Cys+O2 and Heme+Gly+O2, include the actual distance from Fe to the center of the O-O bond as 'Fe-O2_center'. The complex naming follows the paper's convention.

steps.description: Check structural trends: O-O distance ordering Gly > Cys > His, Fe charge more negative for His+O2 than Cys+O2, O2 polarization only in His+O2 (opposite signs on O1 and O2).
steps.details: Each trend contributes 1/3 of the step score.
